contract_term.raw: Two-part answer: no fixed contract term is stated, but a 2-year figure exists for one specific deliverable (ongoing support) within it.

scope_of_deliverables.quote: The Villages are requesting responses to select a consultant to both implement and update data within the Villages Asset Management Software (AMS), consisting of Munisoft PubWorks and ESRI ArcGIS.
scope_of_deliverables.value: Implementation and data update of the Villages' Asset Management Software (Munisoft PubWorks and ESRI ArcGIS): correct/update existing data, implement new shapefiles, enable mobile GIS access, develop processes and train staff, plus 2 years of ongoing software support and consulting.

mandatory_submission_requirements.raw: Item 3's sub-requirements are explicitly conditioned on 'Upon notice of intent to negotiate' - i.e. only required from the winning respondent after selection, not part of every submission, despite being listed under a 'Mandatory Submission Requirements' heading.

mandatory_technical_requirements.quote:
M-1 
Proponent must confirm employees working on the City’s network are willing to sign a Non-Disclosure Agreement and complete a security clearance. 
M-2 
Proponent must confirm they will use Microsoft Teams or Virtual Private Network (VPN) to access any software on the City’s network.
value: M-1: employees working on the network must sign an NDA and complete a security clearance
M-2: must use Microsoft Teams or VPN to access software on the network
M-3: must disclose any past security breach or cybersecurity event, with details, if applicable
M-4: mandatory requirements flow down to subcontractors/3rd parties; data sharing with them limited to the minimum required
M-5: data stored on the Proponent's servers must be on Canadian data centers
M-6: data must be physically or logically separated from other clients' data
mandatory_technical_requirements.raw: M-1 and M-2 literally say 'the City's network', not 'the Village's network' - the RFP is for Summer Villages on Sylvan Lake throughout, so this looks like a copy-paste artifact from a template written for a different (city) client. Recorded the requirements as substantively real regardless of the naming slip.

evaluation_criteria.quote: Rated Criteria will be evaluated independently by each evaluator and the average of all evaluator scores will be the score for a specific criteria.

pricing_structure.quote:
Pricing is worth 35 points of the total score. 
The Proponent submitting the lowest price shall receive the full point value available for the price score. All other Proponent pricing shall be divided into the lowest compliant price received in order to obtain the ratio.
pricing_structure.value: Pricing worth 35 of 100 points: lowest bidder gets full points, others scored as (lowest price / their price) ratio x point value. Four line items: Implement PubWorks+update data (lump sum), Implement ArcGIS+update data (lump sum), Develop Processes+Training (lump sum), Ongoing Maintenance/Support (per hour). Rates in CAD, all-inclusive except GST itemized separately.

insurance_requirements.quote: A valid certificate of insurance with coverage not less than Two (2) Million dollars from an insurance company legally capable of carrying on business within the province of Alberta, names the Village as an additional insured with cross liability, and provides an minimum 30 days notice of any changes to the policy.
insurance_requirements.raw: Only one combined coverage figure, not broken into liability sub-types. Also only required 'upon notice of intent to negotiate', i.e. from the winning respondent, not at submission time.
